conclusions.claim: GH5 V2.8 (MC561, SHA-256 1c7e7538...) index 0 loader1 at file offset 0x1200..0x2200 (rel 0x1000 + 0x200) and S1 V2.4 (MC892, SHA-256 1c54dd84...) index 0 loader1 at file offset 0x1600..0x2600 (rel 0x1400 + 0x200) have identical size (4096B), destination (0x0), flags (3), and 32B candidate_digest (4913f493636ed435d185ca3e5bea7a49eec28195606c99845d38ec68d91ccc5b), while their 4096B raw payloads (6a654e0f... vs 84904a20...) and 16B tail prefixes (8d5ac04a... vs bd515433...) differ.

The +0x200 payload base offset is verified in-file by all flags==2 entries (4/4 in GH5 V2.8 and 7/7 in S1 V2.4 match SHA-256 with +0x200, 0/9 non-empty match without +0x200). The external reference S1___V24.bin.parts.json recorded unshifted relative offsets (off=5120=0x1400), which overlap the last 504B of the 53-entry directory table [0x1400, 0x15f8) and 8B zero padding [0x15f8, 0x1600).

Across the entire 4096B loader1 pair (GH5 vs S1), same-offset byte equality is 20/4096 (0.4883%), bit difference is 16490/32768 (50.3235%), and there are 0 matching 16B blocks at the same index (256), across any aligned indices (256x256=65,536), or across any unaligned 16B sliding windows (4081x4081=16,654,561). The same-model S5 V2.8 vs V2.9 index 0 loader1 pair (4096B, digest e009d688..., identical offset 0x1600 and model MC801, differing only in tail[:16]) exhibits the same full-payload divergence (14/4096 bytes equal, 50.6775% bits changed, 0/16,654,561 16B windows equal), ruling out file-offset or model-string alone as the sole cause of ciphertext divergence without per-entry tail[:16] or per-build randomization.

Under the 5 verified legacy AES-128 keys, digest-independent twin-plaintext differential checks (requiring only that GH5 and S1 loader1, or S5 V2.8 and V2.9 loader1, share at least one 16B plaintext block) produce 0/255 interior block matches in CBC/CFB128/CFB8 and 0/256 block matches in OFB and 5 CTR layouts seeded by tail[:16]. Likewise, seed-independent MT19937 GF(2)-linearity checks on C_A ^ C_B and tail[:16]-seeded TZ10 parity-feedback MT19937 checks produce 0 matches.

Across modern UPD firmwares, loader1 divides into two structural generations: 4096B at index 0 (dest 0x0, followed by loader2 at dest 0x1000 in GH5/S1/S5 and dest 0x20000 in GH4) vs 131072B at index 1 after a 0-byte boot entry (dest 0x0 in S5M2/S1M2/SL3). GH5 V2.8, S1 V2.4, and external reference S1H V2.8 metadata share the exact 4096B loader1 candidate digest 4913f493..., making this 4KiB component the smallest cross-model shared-digest code-slot candidate.

Whether GH5 and S1 index 0 loader1 decrypt to the exact same 4096B plaintext, whether they share a key or key-derivation hierarchy, and the exact consumer formula for candidate_digest and tail[:16] remain unproven until a readable revision=0x200 / selector=3 consumer is located.

confirmed: U-Boot and Linux top-level GNUmakefile files dispatch builds via PVCPF_MTYPE=pvc04v, PVCPF_SUBMODEL, and PVCPF_HW_VERSION to pvc04v_$(PVCPF_SUBMODEL)$(PVCPF_HW_VERSION)_defconfig and pvc04v-$(PVCPF_SUBMODEL)$(PVCPF_HW_VERSION).dtb.
Linux arch/arm64/boot/dts/socionext/Makefile additionally builds pvc04v-$(PVCPF_SUBMODEL)$(PVCPF_HW_VERSION)-shell.dtb, whose -shell.dts source is omitted from all shipped OSS tarballs.

All three U-Boot defconfigs (MC8241, MC8266, MC501) disable CONFIG_SPL and link U-Boot directly at CONFIG_SYS_TEXT_BASE=0x400180000 with CONFIG_BOOTDELAY=-2; U-Boot's board_init/dram_init do not read flash or populate 0x400200000, 0x401290000, 0x4012A0000, or 0x4016A0000.

U-Boot do_unzip (cmd/unzip.c:21-57) -> gunzip (lib/gunzip.c:39-61) only validates standard gzip magic (0x1f 0x8b, method 8) and inflates 0x400200000 to 0x403700000; it contains no decryption or flash read logic.

Linux runs in AMP co-boot mode on cpu@3 only (cpu@0..2 disabled, nr_cpu=1). drivers/irqchip/irq-gic-v3.c (CONFIG_DEBUG_GIC_BL=y) reads the 403-entry GICv3 black-list in pvc04v-MC8241.dts and leaves 403 of 416 SPIs untouched by Linux, including all NAND (SPI 182), eMMC (SPI 183-184), SD1/SD2 (SPI 187-191), and SPI0-2 (SPI 323-325) interrupts.

Linux slram (drivers/mtd/devices/slram.c) and ipcufs (fs/ipcufs.c) are pure consumers. Linux reads the 64-bit physical buffer pool pointer from SHMEM_TOP+0x08 (0x4_AC00_0008) and sync magic base pointer from SHMEM_TOP+0x18 (0x4_AC00_0018) via ioread64, and sni_ipcu_send_msg[_kernel] refuses to send (-EAGAIN) unless the remote RTOS peer has already written SNI_IPCU_MAGIC_CODE (0xBEEFCAFE) into the destination mailbox slot.

In all four kernel defconfigs (MC8241, MC8266, DC1231, DC1232), line 488/486 '# CONFIG_BLK_DEV_INITRD is not set' overrides line 46 'CONFIG_BLK_DEV_INITRD=y'. In init/main.c:1435-1442, ksys_access(ramdisk_execute_command, 0) runs before prepare_namespace(), clearing ramdisk_execute_command ('/sbin/finit') to NULL before /dev/mtdblock0 (slram0) is mounted, so kernel_init executes /sbin/init from slram0.

A full scan of all 710 files in LeicaSL3_OSS.zip::20260612_OSS_SL3/FreeRTOS-202212.00.tar.bz2 returned 0 matches for panasonic/socionext/milbeaut/ipcu/pvc04/sc2006/slram/beefcafe/mc824/dc123, confirming the archive is vanilla upstream FreeRTOS without vendor BSP/loader code.
inferred: The proprietary RTOS / boot loader running on cpu@0..2 (which retains ownership of NAND/eMMC/SD/SPI controllers and 403 GICv3 SPIs) is the sole producer that decrypts/loads U-Boot (0x400180000), ZKERNEL (0x400200000), the active co-boot DTB (0x401290000), slram0 (0x4012A0000), and slram1 (0x4016A0000) into DRAM, populates the descriptor table at 0x4_AC00_0000, writes 0xBEEFCAFE into IPCU mailbox sync slots, and serves ipcufs requests.

The active DTB placed at 0x401290000 at runtime (or built from the omitted -shell.dts target) enables at least snrtos_ipcu00 (dest_mb=0), snrtos_ipcu06 (recv), and snrtos_ipcu07 (send) and adjusts GICv3 black-list/status properties when co-booting with RTOS.
unknown: The exact binary implementation of the proprietary Boot ROM / stage-1 loader / RTOS producer on cpu@0..2 (including its flash partition table parser, decryption routines for 01_loader1.bin..12_main.bin, and the exact physical address written into 0x4_AC00_0008 and 0x4_AC00_0018 at runtime).
The exact contents of the omitted pvc04v-*-shell.dts files and the exact runtime DTB binary loaded at 0x401290000.
The filesystem image format and userland contents inside slram0 (0x4012A0000) and slram1 (0x4016A0000), since their payloads originate from the unrecovered encrypted firmware components.

evidence_gaps.title: 新格式 header revision 0x200 / crypt selector 3 的真实处理代码与消费者
evidence_gaps.detail: 旧机型更新消费者（GH2/TZ10/G3/GF2/GF3/GX1）均只接受 0x101 及 selector 0/1/2，明确拒绝 0x200 和 3；尚缺接受 0x200/selector 3 的可读代码以确认 92B 目录字段、摘要作用对象、32B 尾部用途与密钥/种子来源。

evidence_gaps.title: 将解码/解压前镜像放入 Linux slram / U-Boot gunzip 源 RAM 或远端 IPCU 的前级生产者
evidence_gaps.detail: Linux slram (0x4012A0000/0x4016A0000)、ipcufs (IFSA_READPAGE 0x2004) 和 U-Boot unzip 均为 RAM/远端数据消费者，缺少填充这些 RAM 区域的前级 Boot/RTOS 生产者代码与真实 rootfs (/etc/fstab, init)。

evidence_gaps.title: S1M2 录像质量详情 (114条) 与当前能力枚举 (80项) 的 34 条差集过滤机理与实录验证
evidence_gaps.detail: USB 同会话配对采集已消除 1分55秒时间差，且 10_video_filter 已确认 34 条差集精确对应 pixels > C4K OR fps > 59.94p；尚缺机身侧生成 0x06000013 的过滤分支及切换机身系统频率/图像区域后的只读配对对照。

evidence_gaps.title: LUMIX Lab 蓝牙配对加密载荷、0x01/0x02/0x40 动态用途字节及安全电脑端只读连接器封装
evidence_gaps.detail: 06_lab_control、07_lab_bluetooth 与 08_lab_preview 已闭合 GATT UUID、Wi-Fi 移交状态机及 HTTP/UDP 会话链（LvPort/DTLS）；尚缺蓝牙 bonding 密钥派生与机身侧 CGI 处理器二进制代码。

evidence_gaps.title: S1M2 机内读取 0x051f/0x02f4 的固件消费者、实拍成像视觉验证与 0x9422/0x9423 配置写回边界
evidence_gaps.detail: 11_config_lut 与 2026-10-12 官方受控实验已闭合 .DAT 四字节对齐公式、38 个用户 .cube 正逆向 0 误差双射、0x02f4 41 槽映射(ref-1)、SET26(LutId=27->物理块23)官方单槽导入、正常重启 0 字节差异持久性及单槽重命名(LUT_VERIFY_26)；仍待机内主控固件消费者定位与实拍色彩/0x9422写回验证。

evidence_gaps.title: S1M2 V1.4 实机运行内核是否启用并暴露 FunctionFS 越界索引路径
evidence_gaps.detail: 官方开源包 f_fs.c/composite.c 存在低字节校验与 unsigned 索引不一致，但尚未由只读 USB 描述符/接口归属证据确认 V1.4 实机可达性。

unauthorized_and_prohibited_actions: 未经另行明确授权的一切相机设备通信（USB PTP 主动请求、Wi-Fi HTTP 请求、UDP 发包、蓝牙 GATT 读写/配对）
向相机发送任何设置修改、模式切换（如 camcmd=recmode）、参数枚举写入（如 setsetting/videoquality、0x9403/0x9406/0x9422/0x9423）
向相机发送固件升级或数据上传指令（0x9605/0x9606/startsenddata/senddata/endsenddata）及任何刷写操作
发送 FunctionFS 越界 control transfer（get_alt/set_alt）、长度 DoS 或包含 reset/reboot 的探测请求
在主机直接运行下载的固件、解码镜像、附带 MIPS/ARM ELF、Windows EXE/DLL 或 Android APK
对 S1M2 机身进行拆机、焊接或内部 UART/JTAG 物理探测（注：已拆机设备为 S1RM2，不等同于 S1M2）
在无新消费者或新密钥来源依据时重复运行巨量盲目密钥/模式枚举，或进行全磁盘搜索、下载大体积新固件
修改、删除既有研究目录文件，或向 GitHub 远端提交/推送/发布
